title: Divergence (regression of 2f327b63/#230): user spec fns are now 'pub open' but woven combinator defs (thermite-spec verus_l3 via emit_combinator_defs) stay private — a validator-legal combinator call in a spec fn body gets verus 'in pub open spec function, cannot refer to private function', L0 death

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing test at thermite-lower/tests/divergence_combinator_private_vs_pub_open_spec_fn.rs::pub_open_user_spec_fn_calling_combinator_verifies (verus-backed; skips loudly without verus). spec fn all_small body calling forall_in (validator-legal, spectherm-combinators.md REQ-3 walks SpecFnItem.body) lowers to 'pub open spec fn all_small' naming the PRIVATE woven 'spec fn forall_in' — verus: 'in pub open spec function, cannot refer to private function', live-confirmed. Regression introduced by 2f327b63 (#230): before the pub-open promotion both were private and the unit verified. The REQ-8 visibility-tier class-completion missed the combinator registry defs (thermite-spec combinators.rs verus_l3 / emit_combinator_defs).
